categories.name: Authentication and permissions
gaps: Keycloak runtime SSO/MFA and per-account access require live verification.

categories.name: Customer onboarding / KYC
gaps: KYC routes and compliance source exist; provider-backed verification and account-opening certification are unverified. No dedicated KYC provider credential is admitted yet.

categories.name: Instruments and market information
gaps: Provider symbol mapping, asset-class coverage and trading calendars require provider evidence.

categories.name: Market data
gaps: Live price freshness, streaming entitlements and order-book coverage are unverified.

categories.name: Orders and execution
gaps: PAPER_TRADING_ONLY remains true. Live broker order execution is not enabled or certified.

categories.name: Accounts and balances
gaps: Account detail uses EmptyDetailView. Broker-backed account balances and read-only broker entitlements require separate admission.

categories.name: Positions and portfolio
gaps: Some valuation/performance routes use Disabled. Reconciled live holdings and performance are unverified.

categories.name: Funding and transfers
gaps: Real-value features remain gated. Funding provider selection, beneficiary checks and reconciled bank transfers are unverified.

categories.name: Risk controls
gaps: Several exposure, buying-power and margin routes use FeatureDisabledView. Full pre-trade risk enforcement needs certification.

categories.name: Research and watchlists
gaps: Provider licensing, fundamentals and calendar completeness require verification.

categories.name: Notifications and events
gaps: Notification delivery and event replay require runtime evidence. Shared email/SMS provider master keys belong to their admitted adapters.

categories.name: Reports and audit history
gaps: Complete statements, confirmations and jurisdiction-specific tax documents are not certified by route presence.

categories.name: Operations and monitoring
gaps: Runtime provider health, execution latency and reconciliation alerting are unverified.

connectionTypes.REST_HTTPS: Existing HTTP routing source; private provider authentication stays server-side.
connectionTypes.WebSocket: Realtime source exists; provider stream entitlement and production delivery unverified.
connectionTypes.Webhooks: Provider event signature, replay, idempotency and reconciliation must be certified per integration.
connectionTypes.FIX: No FIX session or provider certification is established by this work; add only if selected broker requires it.
